## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes (typecheck, lint, unit tests, Rust tests)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] No credentials, real keys, signed URLs or personal media anywhere
- [ ] Provider changes cite official documentation in `docs/providers/`
- [ ] Original code only (or third-party code with compatible license recorded in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md)
- [ ] User-facing strings in both English and Turkish
- [ ] No paid API calls in tests unless explicitly opt-in
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated for user-facing changes
